CREATE TABLE "public"."ingress_receipts" (
  "accepted_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "consent_version" int4 NOT NULL,
  "device_id" text NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message_id" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" text NOT NULL,
  "payload_hash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member_devices" (
  "battery_percent" int4,
  "consent_version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "installation_id" text NOT NULL,
  "last_heartbeat_at" timestamp(3),
  "location_consent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "membership_id" text NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" text NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "relay_consent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamp(3),
  "sensing_consent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
